market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo was the Democratic Party candidate in 2022 and received 46.1% of the vote, losing narrowly to incumbent Kim Tae-heum. There is no indication he will not be the nominee again, and his party has a realistic chance to flip the governorship in a competitive province. The current price of 0.8% implies an almost zero probability, which is at least an order of magnitude too low, making the Yes side extremely undervalued.
evidence_points: In the 2022 Chungcheongnam-do gubernatorial election, Yang Seung-jo won 46.1% of the vote, narrowly losing to PPP's Kim Tae-heum (53.9%).
The province is politically competitive, frequently swinging between parties in national and local elections.
Yang Seung-jo remains an active figure in the Democratic Party and is a plausible nominee for 2026, with no public reports of retirement or disqualification.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of South Korean political party dynamics
